description: Land Title Settlement Department - Aluthgama Bogamuwa, Gamapaha D/S Division, Gampaha District
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extents, ownership details, and encumbrances) in the Village of Aluthgama Bogomuwa. The content focuses on land ownership, property rights, and title settlements, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
